sources.publisher: Commonwealth Election Commission of the Northern Mariana Islands
sources.reviewedEvidence: Every certified candidate is compared to an exact row in all 13 official November 3, 2026 specimen fronts by scripts/ba01-south-mp-samples.py. All 77 people, every printed party label, 22 unique rosters and every printed vote limit agree. Governor tickets are paired explicitly by both certification and printed specimen. Precinct 4D has Northern Islands mayor and shares the third-district council and education races; no widening of its separate mayor electorate.

Current FEC Combined Federal/State Disclosure and Election Directory expressly identifies the Commonwealth Election Commission and its URL https://www.votecnmi.gov.mp. This source establishes the .gov.mp publisher; candidate facts come from its current captured certified list and specimen.

The held original Census county code list names MP county equivalents RotaMunicipality69100 and TinianMunicipality69120. Their ZIP county names are aliases of those whole mayor electorates; the current CEC specimens already verify each municipality's mayor race.
